blocks.text: The close of LBC’s 75th anniversary year marks not just the end of a milestone celebration, but the beginning of another chapter in its longstanding journey with the Filipino community. As LBC enters another year, its 75th anniversary anthem continues to bring people together through a special music video produced by Diverse Events in collaboration with Urban Grid Group. The video features rising Filipino P-pop group 1st.One alongside members of the Filipino community in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain, bringing together familiar faces, shared memories, and the unmistakable Filipino spirit of togetherness.
